messages:
maria-cs: Zeta Health pilot asks for an APAC demo routing + QPS bump. Prefer SG, 200 QPS, 72h window starting 2026-04-05T08:00:00Z. Add allowlist: 52.23.12.0/24 and 18.204.0.0/16. Request 30d log retention for audit.

anya-ops: Understood. Allowlist + routing preference needed?

maria-cs: Yes both. They want pin to sg-edge and avoid US fallback unless unavoidable. Renewal signal noted after pilot.

derek-infra: I'll provision a temporary routing override and ACL. If shared pool limits hit, will add provisional capacity tag and auto-revoke. Plan config to push: {"customer":"zeta-health","start":"2026-04-05T08:00:00Z","duration":"72h","region":"ap-southeast-1","qps":200,"ips":["52.23.12.0/24","18.204.0.0/16"],"auto_revoke":true}.

sam-support: Compliance note: 30d logs for health customer — ensure DPA / PHI handling. Maria, confirm demo uses de-identified data.

maria-cs: Confirmed de-identified. I'll attach DPA to CS ticket.

paul-rls: Added renewal play: if p95 <200ms and errors low, push Dedicated conversion in ~60d. Collect feedback during enablement.

derek-infra: Pushed to staging, running smoke tests.

deploy-bot: deploy 2559 -> sg-routing-provisional applied to staging (smoke_ok).

anya-ops: Routing policy `sg_prefer_no_fallback` and IP ACL set. Auto-revoke scheduled 2026-04-08T08:01:00Z.

maria-cs: I'll run enablement call Mon 2026-04-04 to review failover and capture renewal sentiment. :thumbsup:
